blurb: A record pattern or construction may write a field by name alone (`{ total }`), which binds a variable of that name. A reserved word cannot be a variable, so `{ type, .. }` is refused, though `type` is allowed as a field label before a `:`. In a pattern, name the binding: `type: type_`; the compiler offers that fix. In a construction, give the value: `type: "Org"`.
summary: A reserved keyword was used as a field shorthand, which would bind a variable of that name.
